about.key: Games and copies of your files

Oort NX looks for each game’s cover, description, year and genres on the Steam store, Wikipedia and Wikidata. It sends the game’s name, or its Steam number, and your language. Like any site, they see your internet address. No account, no key, and nothing else leaves this computer.

Play tells Steam on this computer which game to start. While you browse, Oort sends Steam each game’s number and your language to get its pictures, information and achievements.
